facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's PFM Reform Strategy 2026-2030 reports that the Somalia Financial Management Information System (SFMIS) was implemented, with paperless commitment-to-payment processes, an operational asset management module, a link to the Central Bank's core banking system and SFMIS rolled out to the Federal Member States under SERP; no event date is given, so the document's published date is used.

systems.country_label: Integrated Tax Administration System (named as a revenue administration system being developed)
Non-tax revenue portal integrated with SFMIS
